## 3e89f914acb3

**Reproduced defect — palette/cardinality controls are inert.** Source hash:
`d58bd18eac4e9688afc95d3f6893cb481d05ca59561704c64804bff9c611d2be`.
At seed 0/sample 0 with lawful dimensions and
`seeds=5, n_distinct_colors=1, palette_size=1, palette_kind=warm, texture=warm`,
the generator returned five seeds using colors `[1,7,8]`; `self_check` returned
no errors. The source never consults the helpful palette/texture/cardinality
controls and instead samples each seed from colors 1–9. Across the retained
20-seed probe, every accepted board ignored the requested one-color constraint;
one seed also produced only four of the requested five seeds after placement
search exhausted.

The isolated audit preset likewise found no task-local tests and failed the
strict semantic stage because no contract is declared. I did not edit this audit
target. Exact grids, all 20 seeds, source hash, and command are in
`checks/audit/3e89f914acb3-override-reproducer.json`; isolated-stage evidence is
under `checks/audit/3e89f914acb3-combined/`.

## 3e89f914acb3

**Reproduced defect — palette/cardinality controls are inert and the validator
does not enforce seed isolation.** Current source SHA-256
`d58bd18eac4e9688afc95d3f6893cb481d05ca59561704c64804bff9c611d2be`.
At seed 0/sample 0, a lawful 10×10 request for five seeds with
`n_distinct_colors=1,palette_size=1,palette_kind=warm,texture=warm` returns five
seeds using four colors `[1,4,7,9]`; `self_check` returns `[]`. A separate 6×6
input with adjacent differently colored seeds at Manhattan distance one also
passes `self_check`, contradicting the documented isolated/nonoverlapping-seed
invariants.

Exact grids, controls, counts, source hash, and command are in
`checks/audit/3e89f914acb3/result.json`; the runnable reproducer is
`checks/audit/3e89f914acb3/reproduce.py`. The isolated audit preset found no
task-local tests and failed the required semantic contract; evidence is under
`checks/audit/3e89f914acb3-combined/`. No source file was modified.
